run_searchbot_agent: run a SearchBotAgent with CFR search to compute equilibrium policies for all powers in a Diplomacy game
get_orders_for_power: get the final orders for a specific power by running CFR search and sampling from the resulting policy
generate_diplomatic_message: generate a diplomatic message between two powers using the message handler with optional message search and pseudo-orders
compute_plausible_orders_policy: compute the blueprint policy for all agents by sampling plausible orders and optionally applying augmentation like double oracle
run_cfr_search: run a CFR search iteration loop to compute average and final policies for all powers with optional bilateral stats tracking
